test_title: PYST 20: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Go through the roof
solution:
The correct answer is **'****Rise very high'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Go through the roof**: to rise to a very high level.

 
 
• **Example:** Prices have **gone through the roof.**
 
 
 
• Thus, from above we can say that the correct answer is **option 1.**
